gaps.finding: The inference log implementation violates the privacy-by-design principle by logging raw input and output text containing potentially sensitive data.
gaps.evidence: scripts/inference_log.py:35-36: "\"input\": input_text, \"output\": output_text"
gaps.recommendation: Implement redaction or hashing of input/output text in the logging function to prevent the persistence of personal data in logs.
